tasks.title: Core Application Architecture Setup
tasks.description: Set up the foundational Electron application structure with React/TypeScript, including main process, renderer process, and IPC communication for Engie AI assistant
tasks.details: Create the basic Electron app structure with proper TypeScript configuration, React setup, and inter-process communication channels. This includes configuring the main process for native macOS integration and the renderer process for the user interface.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the application launches successfully, main and renderer processes communicate properly, and basic React components render correctly.

tasks.title: Real-time Text Analysis Engine
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive text analysis system with grammar checking, spell checking, tone analysis, and clarity scoring
tasks.details: Build a robust text processing engine that can analyze text in real-time for grammar errors, spelling mistakes, tone detection, and readability metrics. The engine should be modular and support multiple analysis modes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various text samples, verify accuracy of grammar and spell checking, ensure real-time performance under 200ms response time.

tasks.title: Conversational AI Chat Interface
tasks.description: Create an intuitive chat interface for AI conversations focused on writing support, motivation, and philosophical guidance
tasks.details: Design and implement a chat component that facilitates natural conversations with the AI assistant. Include features for writing coaching, brainstorming, emotional support, and motivational guidance with Engie's encouraging personality.
tasks.testStrategy: Test conversation flows, verify AI responses are contextually appropriate, ensure UI is responsive and user-friendly.

tasks.title: macOS Native Integration
tasks.description: Implement native macOS features including menu bar integration, system notifications, keyboard shortcuts, and appearance adaptation
tasks.details: Build deep macOS integration with menu bar presence, native notification system, global keyboard shortcuts, dark/light mode adaptation, and proper window management following macOS Human Interface Guidelines.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify menu bar functionality, test notifications across different system states, ensure keyboard shortcuts work globally, confirm appearance changes with system settings.

tasks.title: AI Model Integration & Management
tasks.description: Implement multi-provider AI integration supporting Claude, GPT-4, and other models with intelligent fallback mechanisms
tasks.details: Create a flexible AI service layer that can work with multiple AI providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4, etc.) with automatic fallback, rate limiting, and cost optimization. Include local processing options for privacy.
tasks.testStrategy: Test API integrations with different providers, verify fallback mechanisms work correctly, ensure error handling and retry logic functions properly.

tasks.title: Writing Progress & Analytics Dashboard
tasks.description: Build analytics system to track writing improvements, usage patterns, and goal achievement with privacy-compliant metrics
tasks.details: Create a dashboard that shows writing statistics, improvement trends, goal tracking, and usage analytics while maintaining user privacy. Include visualizations for progress over time and achievement milestones.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify accuracy of metrics tracking, test data visualization components, ensure privacy compliance and no sensitive data leakage.

tasks.title: Privacy & Security Framework
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive privacy controls including local-only processing mode, data encryption, and privacy-first architecture
tasks.details: Build privacy-centric features including optional local-only text processing, encrypted data transmission, no keystroke logging without consent, and GDPR compliance mechanisms.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct security audits, verify encryption implementation, test local-only mode functionality, ensure compliance with privacy regulations.

tasks.title: Settings & Customization System
tasks.description: Create comprehensive settings panel for user preferences, AI behavior customization, and privacy controls
tasks.details: Design and implement a settings interface that allows users to customize Engie's behavior, choose AI models, set privacy preferences, configure notifications, and personalize the writing assistance experience.
tasks.testStrategy: Test all setting configurations, verify preferences persist correctly, ensure UI is intuitive and accessible.

tasks.title: System-wide Text Monitoring (Optional)
tasks.description: Implement optional background text monitoring across macOS applications with strict privacy controls
tasks.details: Create an optional feature that can monitor text input across system applications to provide contextual writing assistance. Must include granular permissions, easy disable options, and transparent operation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test across various applications, verify permission controls work correctly, ensure performance impact is minimal, confirm easy opt-out functionality.

tasks.title: Performance Optimization & Testing
tasks.description: Optimize application performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency with comprehensive testing suite
tasks.details: Implement performance optimizations for real-time text processing, minimize memory footprint, optimize for battery life, and create comprehensive test coverage including unit tests, integration tests, and performance benchmarks.
tasks.testStrategy: Benchmark performance metrics, verify memory usage stays under 100MB, test battery impact, achieve 95%+ test coverage.

tasks.title: CRITICAL: LangGraph Workflow Integration
tasks.description: Integrate LangGraph for intelligent workflow automation - MANDATORY for Gauntlet technical evaluation
tasks.details: Implement LangGraph workflow chains: text analysis → task creation → background processing. Add multi-step reasoning for task decomposition and intelligent workflow automation. Create workflow engine in main process with real-time status updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Test workflow chain execution, verify multi-step reasoning works, ensure background processing completes successfully, validate real-time status updates.

tasks.title: Background Processing Engine
tasks.description: Implement local workflow execution system with background worker threads
tasks.details: Create background worker threads in main process, workflow queue and state management, real-time status updates to renderer. Implement job scheduling and monitoring for local workflow execution.
tasks.testStrategy: Test background thread creation, verify workflow queue processes correctly, ensure state management persists across app restarts, validate real-time updates.

tasks.title: TaskMaster UI Integration
tasks.description: Surface TaskMaster functionality directly in Engie UI for seamless task management
tasks.details: Build task sidebar panel component, live TaskMaster MCP integration, quick task creation from text selection. Integrate existing TaskMaster functionality into the main Engie interface.
tasks.testStrategy: Test task panel UI, verify MCP integration works correctly, ensure task creation from text selection functions, validate live updates from TaskMaster.

tasks.title: Enhanced Chat Interface with Workflow Integration
tasks.description: Upgrade chat interface with professional experience and workflow integration capabilities
tasks.details: Add smart typing indicators, message categorization (insight/encouragement/task), task creation from chat messages. Integrate with workflow engine for intelligent task suggestions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test message categorization accuracy, verify task creation from chat works, ensure typing indicators function properly, validate workflow integration.

tasks.title: LangGraph-Powered Text Analysis
tasks.description: Implement intelligent real-time text analysis using LangGraph workflows
tasks.details: Background text processing with LangGraph, writing pattern recognition, auto-task generation suggestions. Integrate with existing text analyzer to provide intelligent insights.
tasks.testStrategy: Test real-time analysis performance, verify pattern recognition accuracy, ensure auto-task suggestions are relevant, validate background processing efficiency.

tasks.title: MVP UI/UX Polish
tasks.description: Professional visual improvements for tester-ready MVP presentation
tasks.details: Add loading states and animations, error handling and fallbacks, performance optimizations, responsive design improvements. Ensure professional appearance for beta testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test all loading states, verify error handling works correctly, ensure responsive design across window sizes, validate animation performance.

tasks.title: Integration Testing & Bug Fixes
tasks.description: End-to-end testing and bug fixes for stable MVP operation
tasks.details: End-to-end workflow testing, performance verification, cross-feature integration testing. Ensure stable operation for testers with comprehensive bug fixes.
tasks.testStrategy: Complete end-to-end test suite, verify all features work together, ensure no critical bugs remain, validate performance meets requirements.

tasks.title: Tester Documentation
tasks.description: Create comprehensive documentation for MVP beta testers
tasks.details: Quick setup guide, feature demonstration script, known limitations documentation. Ensure testers can effectively evaluate all MVP features.
tasks.testStrategy: Test documentation accuracy, verify setup guide works for new users, ensure demonstration script covers all features.

metadata.description: macOS desktop app for AI-powered writing assistance and motivation
